items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: we had Louie Armstrong group, Phil Harris, Florence Henderson, just everybody in show business.

ctx.x: was it a syndicated TV series? (Inaudible).

Yeah. Now, the format was similar to the Bob Hope Christmas Show. We would go to various army camps, and do shows there, and they'd have the greatest acts in show business. You know, the money was no object. We had the greatest acts in show business every -- we had Louie Armstrong group, Phil Harris, Florence Henderson, just everybody in show business. But the war -- that was a very unpopular war, this Vietnam war, and nobody -- no sponsor really wanted to be identified with anything concerning this war. So I…
But it was a very good show, and an enjoyable show because it was just such a wonderful band. Yeah.
